# FunctionalRelevanceDrivenSelfOrganization

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A principle where system components self-organize based on their functional contribution to overall system survival, rather than predefined structural roles. Provides a theoretical framework for designing adaptive neuromorphic topologies that can reconfigure themselves to maintain critical functions under changing conditions.
